transfer_requirements: Copy the complete manifest, database.dump and sources directory together through an authorized private channel; preserve all 7 source entries and all 44 supplement entries.
Do not copy only the four textbook PDFs: historical authored originals, source-specific publisher/OCR transcription JSON, rendered PNG and raw OCR records are needed to validate retained references.
Keep the original backup and original database unchanged. Restore only into a distinct new database and empty distinct storage directory.

The restore helper verifies all hashes, restores the dump and remaps source storage paths, then verifies corpus/history/profile fingerprints. It writes a new restore report next to the transferred manifest.
Copy/download the exact E5 model cache separately; model weights are not in this database/source backup. Real SciQ/private experiment files are separate and not implied to be in the backup.

After restore configure only the new clone/API/worker to the new database and matching restored STORAGE_ROOT. Original record IDs are valid only with that matching restored database. Never reuse old registry IDs against a fresh empty database.

The old report endpoint 55432 is historical evidence. Current local database access is 15432 as recorded separately by the handover runtime verification. Process environment can override .env; use the verified endpoint for the intended new instance.
